videos.name: four_questions_en
videos.title: 4 Questions
videos.title_en: 4 Questions You Will Be Asked on the Day of Judgment
videos.caption: Your feet will not move on the Day of Judgment until you are asked about 4 things… Which one would you struggle with? Comment 1, 2, 3 or 4 👇

lines.text: On the Day of Judgment, {your feet will not move}…
lines.say: On the Day of Judgment, | your feet | will not *move*,

lines.text: until you are asked about {4 things}.
lines.say: until you are asked | about *four* things.

lines.label: Question 1
lines.text: Your {life}: how did you spend it?
lines.say: Your *life*: | how did you spend it?

lines.label: Question 2
lines.text: Your {knowledge}: what did you do with it?
lines.say: Your *knowledge*: | what did you do with it?

lines.label: Question 3
lines.text: Your {wealth}: where did you earn it, and where did you spend it?
lines.say: Your *wealth*: | where did you earn it, | and where did you spend it?

lines.label: Question 4
lines.text: Your {body}: how did you use it?
lines.say: Your *body*: | how did you use it?

lines.text: Four questions. {No one} can answer them for you.
lines.say: Four questions. | *No one* | can answer them for you.

lines.text: And your answers are being written {today}.
lines.say: And your answers | are being written | *today*.

lines.label: Allah says
lines.sub: “Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.” (At-Takathur 102:8)
lines.say: Then you will surely be asked that Day | about *pleasure*.

lines.text: Which one would you struggle with? Comment {1, 2, 3 or 4}.
lines.say: Which one would you struggle with? | Comment | one, two, three, | or four.

sources.grade: hasan sahih (at-Tirmidhi), sahih (al-Albani); Zubair Ali Zai: da'if - graders differ
sources.wording: faithful rendering of the linked English translation
